router_distinctions:
Select the tier whose capabilities best fit the task — Under-escalating (using a tier too weak for the task) is just as costly as over-escalating, because it produces poor results that require retries.

When in doubt: Consider what happens if the selected tier is too weak for the task. If failure or poor quality is likely, escalate. The goal is a correct result on the first attempt, not minimal cost.

tiers.name: haiku
tiers.router_label: Casual conversation, simple factual questions, short summaries, translations, web searches, running scheduled jobs, invoking tools, simple file creation, quick edits, toggling settings

tiers.name: sonnet
tiers.router_label: Code review, debugging, explaining complex concepts, research synthesis, editing code files, implementing features, fixing bugs, creating scripts, writing tests, multi-file changes

tiers.name: opus
tiers.router_label: Architecture design, system-level reasoning, complex trade-off analysis, large-scale refactoring, implementing complex features, redesigning system architecture, building new modules from scratch

tiers.name: agent
tiers.description: Multi-agent orchestrator for complex multi-step tasks requiring parallel work by multiple specialized agents
